policies.editor.disableSuccess: Rule disabled; its definition remains in immutable history.
policies.editor.deleteConfirmBody: The rule is removed in a new rule-set version; its definition remains in immutable history and existing decisions are unaffected.

policies.editor.deleteError: The rule could not be deleted: {{message}}
